verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs confirm Templates as reusable saved layouts that form the base for every new Object of a type, including custom icon/cover — directly matching the 'reusable template' part of the story. However, there is no documentation of dynamic variables (e.g., auto-filled date, title placeholders) within templates, only static layout/icon/cover presets. missing for 10: explicit support for variable/placeholder fields (date, title auto-fill) in templates, and independent/hands-on confirmation of variable-based template use.
